_doc: Published figures for each variant, with their source. FM = US Army FM 3-23.30, Grenades and Pyrotechnic Signals, 15 Oct 2009 (table, PDF page). Only exterior and effect figures are used; the tables' filler and fuze rows are deliberately not recorded here. 'impact' is game-only: every one of its numbers is game tuning.

shape.diameter_source: public figure (2.5 in, widely published for the M67; not in Table A-1); the limb in Fig. A-2 fits a circle

impact.title: Impact (game-only)
impact.source: GAME: no real reference. Body and weight copied from frag; it does not imitate any real impact fuze

flash.title: Stun / flash (M84 exterior)
flash.throw_source: INFERRED: Table A-5 gives no throwing distance; the frag's 35 m is used because the weights differ by 5 %

shape.note: 5.25 in long, 1.73 in across the hexagon corners (Table A-5); drag uses a 35 mm cylinder of the same length

smoke.title: Coloured smoke (M18 exterior): red, yellow, green, violet

shape.note: can 2.5 in (Table B-3, same can family) x 117.5 mm measured in Fig. B-3, plus the fuze
